# mikrotik-axi

Read-mostly CLI for RouterOS v7 over REST. Output is TOON: compact, pre-aggregated, with
`help[]` hints for the next step. Errors go to stdout with `error:`/`code:`; exit 2 means
bad usage, exit 1 means the device or config failed.

## Start here

Run `npx -y mikrotik-axi` with no arguments. It prints the home view:

- `device`: profile name, identity check, RouterOS version, uptime
- `health`: cpu, memory, temperature
- `wan`: PPPoE sessions running and per physical line
- `main_default`: active default route(s) of table `main`
- `dhcp`: servers and bound leases
- `alerts[n]{id,message}`: findings from the checks below (one per line)
- `help[]`: the next command to run

## Commands

| Command | What it returns |
| --- | --- |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi home` | health summary + alerts (same as no arguments; accepts flags) |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi devices` | every profile device: identity check, version, reachability |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi health` | identity, board, version, uptime, cpu, memory, temperature, update status |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi wan [ips]` | PPPoE sessions per physical line; `ips` = public IP per session |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi routes <defaults\|rules>` | default routes per routing-table; /routing/rule vs mangle |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi dhcp [leases <server>]` | DHCP servers, bound leases, pool usage |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi vlans` | VLAN interfaces with addresses |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi iface [--type t]` | interfaces, running state, byte counters |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi fw <filter\|nat\|mangle\|raw> [check \| enable\|disable <.id>]` | firewall rules in order; mangle MSS/mark audit; WRITE: enable/disable a rule |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi services` | management services and their real ACL (available-from) |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi log [--topic t] [--since 1h] [--grep re]` | recent router log |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi pppoe restart <name>` | WRITE: restart one PPPoE session (dry-run unless --confirm) |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi arp flush <address>` | WRITE: drop a dynamic ARP entry (dry-run unless --confirm) |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi addr-list add\|remove <list> <address>` | WRITE: one firewall address-list entry (dry-run unless --confirm) |
| `npx -y mikrotik-axi revert <snapshot-file>` | WRITE: undo a change from its snapshot (dry-run unless --confirm) |

Every command accepts `--device <name>`, `--fields a,b`, `--full` (no row limit or text
truncation) and `--help`. Lists longer than 50 rows print `count: 50 of N total`.

## Alerts

| id | Fires when |
| --- | --- |
| `pppoe-down` | fewer PPPoE sessions running than expected (profile expect.pppoe_running, else all enabled) |
| `main-default` | table main does not have exactly one active default, or its gateway differs from expect.main_default_gateway |
| `no-netwatch` | on PPPoE routers: nothing would notice the main default losing the Internet behind a live session |
| `mss-order` | a change-mss rule sits after the first accept of its mangle chain and never runs |
| `mss-raise` | numeric new-mss without a tcp-mss filter raises smaller MSS values |
| `service-open` | an enabled /ip/service has an empty available-from (reverse-proxy with no rules is reported as idle, not open) |
| `mac-server` | MAC telnet/winbox allowed on all interfaces |
| `loop-protect` | enabled bridge ports with neither loop-protect nor bpdu-guard |
| `zero-hit` | rule groups (by comment stem) with 0 packets after at least a day of uptime |
| `dup-mark` | duplicate mangle mark-routing (same chain, source and mark) |
| `version` | a newer RouterOS is reported by the router's own last update check |

## Rules the tool already enforces (do not work around them)

- **Identity before anything.** The tool first probes the address without credentials and
  stops unless a RouterOS answers, then compares `/system/identity` with the profile. An IP
  is not an identity: another network may reuse the subnet. Only read commands accept
  `--no-identity-check`.
- **Default routes are per routing-table.** Never add counts across tables.
- **Mangle wins over /routing/rule.** A packet already marked by mangle never consults
  /routing/rule; `routes rules` shows which rules mangle already decides.
- **`/ip/service` ACL is `available-from`.** The `address` field is always empty on v7.
- **Dynamic routes cannot be edited.** Change `default-route-distance` on the pppoe-client.

## Writes

Commands marked WRITE print a plan and change nothing unless `--confirm` is given. With
`--confirm` they re-check identity (never skippable), refuse dynamic objects and objects the
profile protects, save a snapshot, write, read the value back (a write that silently did
nothing exits 1), and print `mikrotik-axi revert <snapshot> --confirm`. Already in the wanted
state ⇒ `result: no-op`. `MIKROTIK_AXI_READ_ONLY=1` refuses every `--confirm`. Show the plan
to the user and get approval before adding `--confirm`. There is no command that runs
arbitrary RouterOS scripts.

## Setup

Credentials come only from the environment (`MIKROTIK_AXI_USER` / `MIKROTIK_AXI_PASS` or the
names in the profile); devices from a JSON profile (`MIKROTIK_AXI_PROFILE`). Use a read-only
RouterOS user. `mikrotik-axi setup hooks` installs a SessionStart hook that prints the home
view (read-only, 3 s budget, silent outside `MIKROTIK_AXI_HOOK_DIRS`).
